bands.name: always-on
bands.description: fire_rate > 0.95 — unconditional, fires on nearly every token

bands.name: pure-token
bands.description: top trigger_rate > 0.90 — deterministic on specific token(s)

bands.name: selective

bands.name: contextual

bands.name: diffuse
